ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) in central lobe regions versus 40% low-intensity (black) at the leading edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of high-intensity white contiguous blocks. Peripheral regions, including the leading edges and the distal tips (left and right), exhibit solid low-intensity black pigmentation. A gradient of mottled dark pixels exists at the junction between the lobes and the peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary across both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a distinct semi-circular indentation approximately one-third of the way from the tip. High-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) are visible along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature across the trailing edge, sweeping upward to sharp, narrow points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of low-intensity focal spots (black dots) scattered within the high-intensity white regions of the lobes, primarily clustered near the bottom edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, non-symmetrical notch or loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Human-readable alphanumeric metadata at the bottom of the frame: 'NAHWC #4038' and 'YoNAH #Y2846'.
